name: RMM and ASSOCIATES
semiconductor_relevance: None -- the company's focus is on industrial specialty consumables, not directly on semiconductors
summary: RMM and ASSOCIATES, part of the Malu Group, provides industrial specialty consumables aimed at improving design and operational efficiency in industrial equipment and machinery. Their offerings focus on lubrication, adhesion, sealing, corrosion, and reclamation/repairs, primarily serving OEM and MRO industries.
